name: Checkbox
summary: Let a user turn one or more independent options on or off.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-checkbox> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. CSS lives in the component's shadow DOM, so both frameworks render byte-identical pixels; theming comes only from --aha-* tokens. Zero drift — the same element, not two look-alikes.

whenToUse.when: one or more independent options; applies on submit
exactly one from a small mutually-exclusive set
a single setting that takes effect immediately

opinion.note: Labels are sentence case and state what the control does — 'Let participants join anonymously', not 'Join Anonymously'. Keep product nouns: Q&A, Word cloud.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — enumerated from the DS V3 Checkbox component-set taxonomy (Checkbox · Checkbox-Input · Form-Item/Checkbox · TableCellControl): the family carries the three ticks (unchecked · checked · indeterminate/mixed) × rest/hover/disabled. The measured reference (contract.json cells checkbox|rest, |rest|hover, |checked, |disabled) enumerates NO size axis — DS V3 Checkbox is single-size (14×14 r4), so no `size` prop is stubbed. Token layer: white surface, checked fill color-primary #6A1EBB + white 12px tick, hover border purple-30 #D3B4FF, disabled bg-container-disabled #F1F1F1 / border-disabled #EBEBEB. a11y: host role=checkbox with aria-checked true/false/mixed synced from observedAttributes; the native <input> is aria-hidden so AT announces once; Space on the focusable host toggles. Motion on the persistent .box (never rebuilt on toggle).

a11y.role: checkbox on the host; aria-checked reflects true / false / mixed (indeterminate)
a11y.keyboard: host is focusable (tabindex 0, -1 when disabled); Space toggles
a11y.note: The visually-hidden native <input> is aria-hidden=true so screen readers announce the control once via the host role.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step. The fast path for vibe-coding.

codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. The only per-framework code is binding glue (React < 19 needs the ref wrapper; Vue consumes it natively). The primitive is defined once in @aha/design.

selfCheck.label: indeterminate shows the mixed bar, aria-checked=mixed

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, so there is a single render (no per-framework roots).
